facts.text: The hotel is in Berlin City West, by the Kurfürstendamm shopping district.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the prestigious neighbourhoods of Berlin City West, by the luxury shopping district of Kurfürstendamm

facts.text: The Berlin Zoo and Tiergarten park are just across the street from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: major attractions—including the Berlin Zoo and Tiergarten park—are just across the street

facts.text: The hotel is set in a skyscraper in City West.
facts.excerpt: set in an elegant skyscraper in City West

facts.text: The Berlin property opened in 2013.
facts.excerpt: the Berlin property, which opened in 2013

facts.text: It is the sole Waldorf Astoria in Germany.
facts.excerpt: It’s the only Waldorf Astoria in Germany.

facts.text: Peacock Alley is named after a corridor that connected the original Waldorf Hotel to the Astoria in New York.
facts.excerpt: Named after a grand corridor connecting the original Waldorf Hotel to its sister, the Astoria, in New York, Peacock Alley at the Waldorf Astoria Berlin is a modern interpretation of its New York sister.

facts.text: Peacock Alley in the lobby has the Waldorf's signature grandfather clock.
facts.excerpt: Art Deco-inspired Peacock Alley, adorned with the Waldorf’s signature grandfather clock

facts.text: ROCA blends Italian cuisine with the urban spirit of New York.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of Berlin’s City West, ROCA blends Italian soul with the urban spirit of New York.

facts.text: ROCA has a hand-painted ceiling mural.
facts.excerpt: highlighted by a flamboyant hand-painted ceiling mural

facts.text: ROCA has a terrace used on warm days.
facts.excerpt: On warm days, the terrace becomes a favorite spot to unwind while the vibrant life of Berlin passes by.

facts.text: The Lang Bar has Art Deco surroundings and serves Film Noir-inspired drinks.
facts.excerpt: Sit back and relax in the lush Art Deco surroundings while you enjoy one of many Film Noir-inspired drinks

facts.text: The Lang Bar channels the film director Fritz Lang.
facts.excerpt: Channeling the legendary film director Fritz Lang, the Lang Bar sports a cool Art Deco vibe

facts.text: The Library Lounge on the 15th floor serves afternoon tea with views across the city.
facts.excerpt: enjoying afternoon tea with views across the city from the 15th-floor Library Lounge

facts.text: The Champagne and Eggs all-day breakfast serves Waldorf Astoria inventions such as Eggs Benedict.
facts.excerpt: Waldorf Astoria inventions such as Eggs Benedict are served alongside fresh, stacked, blueberry pancakes.

facts.text: Times Square is the hotel's breakfast restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Times Square, our light-filled breakfast restaurant

facts.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa is on the fifth floor.
facts.excerpt: is located on the fifth floor and includes five therapy rooms, a cloud-shaped pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, terrace

facts.text: The spa has a cloud-shaped pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, five therapy rooms and a terrace.
facts.excerpt: includes five therapy rooms, a cloud-shaped pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, terrace, five-senses hydrotherapy, 24-hour gym

facts.text: The spa's signature treatments were created for the hotel by the brand BABOR.
facts.excerpt: Exclusively for the Waldorf Astoria Berlin, the prestigious brand BABOR has created exceptional wellness experiences

facts.text: The spa sun terrace has views of the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church.
facts.excerpt: unwind on our sun terrace while enjoying beautiful views of the iconic Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church

facts.text: The fitness area is open 24/7 with Technogym equipment new in 2025.
facts.excerpt: our 24/7 training area is equipped with brand-new Technogym equipment (2025)

facts.text: Spa access costs hotel guests 15 euros per person per day; it is complimentary for Tower Suite guests and Hilton Honors Silver, Gold and Diamond members.
facts.excerpt: Access to the Waldorf Astoria Spa is available to hotel guests for a fee of €15 per person, per day. Spa access is complimentary for guests staying in our Tower Suites and for Hilton Honors Silver, Gold and Diamond members.

facts.text: The spa won the World Luxury Spa Award for Best Luxury Spa and Germany's Best Hotel Spa.
facts.excerpt: winner of the World Luxury Spa Award for Best Luxury Spa and Germany’s Best Hotel Spa

facts.text: All rooms and suites feature a marble bathroom, Nespresso coffee machine, dining table and safe.
facts.excerpt: All rooms and suites feature a marble bathroom, Nespresso coffee machine, TV, dining table, WiFi access and safe.

facts.text: Rooms have a dining table for private dining, a nod to Waldorf Astoria, where room service is said to have been invented.
facts.excerpt: In keeping with the history of Waldorf Astoria, where room service is said to have been invented, a comfortable dining table for two is available for private fine dining.

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms with view look over Berlin, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church or the Zoo.
facts.excerpt: Panoramic views of Berlin, the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church or Zoo

facts.text: Tower Suites on the upper floors have a kitchenette and access to the tower lift.
facts.excerpt: On the upper floors (22 to 29), the King Tower Suites offer a private living area, a kitchenette and access to the tower lift.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a grand piano and a fireplace.
facts.excerpt: marvel at exquisite furnishings such as a grand piano, fireplace, and specially-designed Royal porcelain

facts.text: All rooms are non-smoking; smoking is only possible on the balconies of the Tower Suites.
facts.excerpt: All our rooms are non-smoking, smoking is only possible on the balconies of the Tower Suites.

facts.text: The Family Deluxe Room combines a King Deluxe and an adjoining Twin Deluxe Room and sleeps two adults and two children.
facts.excerpt: Comprised of a King Deluxe and adjoining Twin Deluxe Room. Sleeps two adults and two children.

facts.text: ROCA offers a kid-friendly menu.
facts.excerpt: the ROCA restaurant offers a kid-friendly menu

facts.text: Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult in the spa.
facts.excerpt: Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.

facts.text: Butler service is available on request.
facts.excerpt: There’s also butler service available upon request.

facts.text: When the Lang Bar is closed in summer, the seasonal Mistral Rooftop Restaurant and Bar on the sixth floor serves drinks.
facts.excerpt: When the Lang Bar is closed in summer, head to the seasonal Mistral Rooftop Restaurant and Bar (which is actually on the sixth floor)

facts.text: The hotel has 228 rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: one of Waldorf Astoria Berlin’s 228 rooms and suites

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is Berlin's highest five-star Presidential Suite and the city's leading hotel suite.
facts.excerpt: On the 31st floor, Berlin’s highest five-star Presidential Suite is the city’s ‘leading hotel suite’ with unparalleled luxury and privacy.

contradictions.note: p2 puts Tower Suites on floors 22 to 29 (Astor Suite 30, Presidential 31); p5 says Tower Suites are floors 22 to 31
